_comment: GH Archive issue/PR lifecycles (gharchive.org). Entity=issue/PR, state=(status,labels,assignee,milestone) rendered text, action=real GH event. The closest real-world analog to data/entity_world: one entity/chain, explicit per-transition actions, HIGH determinism-given-action (measured ~0.93 modal-next on a 9-hour sample; a full month with more label/assignee churn lifts both vocab and determinism). PAIRS mode (chains mostly length 2). vocab 8192 (actual ~6.3K on the sample; a month grows label/login vocab). max_text_tokens=64 covers >99% of states (p99=46). For the OOD-entity probe, build train/test from two non-overlapping date ranges (issues created after the cutoff = unseen entities) instead of the iid split.
